subject: Quarterly review + product demo — schedule & attendees
message_1_subject: Quarterly review + product demo — schedule & attendees
message_1_body:
Hi Aisha and Tom,

Hope you9re well. As discussed on our sync, we9d like to run a 45-minute product demo for the Nimbus Health account and align on Q2 objectives with your executive sponsor. Goal: 1) show the new caching + routing improvements that reduce latency for your patient-facing flows, 2) validate the rollout plan and timelines for Dedicated deployment, and 3) confirm any procurement/security blockers ahead of contract conversations.

Proposed attendees:
- Nimbus: Aisha (Engineering), Tom (Lead PM), Rajiv (VP Ops) optional but helpful
- Redwood: Rishi (AE), Sergio (SE), Lauren (Account Manager), Maya (VP Customer Success)

I have two initial slots available next week (all PT):
- Tue Apr 14, 10:00-10:45
- Thu Apr 16, 09:00-09:45

If neither work, please propose 2 alternative 45-min windows. Also, if procurement/security need a separate 15-20 minute pre-call for the checklist, we can schedule that with Sergio.

I9ve attached a short demo deck and a security checklist for review.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf, redwood-security-checklist-2026.xlsx
message_2_subject: Re: Quarterly review + product demo — schedule & attendees
message_2_body:
Thanks Rishi. Tue Apr 14 10:00PT looks good for engineering and PM, but Rajiv (our VP) is traveling that day. Procurement and security are cc9d and they9ve asked for a short pre-call to review the checklist and billing flow before the exec-level session.

Would you be able to do a 20-minute security/procurement pre-call on Mon Apr 13 at 11:00PT? If you9re not available then, procurement suggested Mon 13 at 15:00PT.

Also copying Tom9s calendar (t.ellis) and procurement so they can confirm.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Khan | Director of Engineering, Nimbus Health
message_3_subject: Re: Quarterly review + product demo — schedule & attendees
message_3_body:
Hi all,

Happy to run the security/procurement pre-call. Mon Apr 13 at 11:00PT works for me — I9ll prepare a 15-20 minute tech checklist walk-through: architecture diagram, network requirements, KV cache persistence options, and the list of logs/audit events we can expose.

Can you confirm whether the pre-call should include engineering-only items (ports, VPC peering) or if procurement needs pricing/license details during that same slot? If procurement prefers, we can keep it engineering-only and schedule a follow-up billing/terms chat.

Regards,
Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood
message_4_subject: Re: Quarterly review + product demo — schedule & attendees
message_4_body:
Hi Rishi / Sergio,

Procurement here. Thanks for the invite. We9d like the pre-call to include a short pricing overview (commit vs usage), billing contact confirmation, and a copy of your standard terms/MSA redlines if available. If you could share a preliminary purchase terms draft and the billing contact name before the pre-call, that would be helpful.

Attaching a stub with our vendor intake form for reference.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Nimbus Health

Attachments: vendor-intake-form.pdf
message_5_subject: Updated: Quarterly review + product demo — calendar + pre-call detail
message_5_body:
Thanks everyone — quick update after the pre-call: Sergio will run the technical walkthrough today (11:00PT) and procurement confirmed they9ll join for the first 10 minutes to cover billing and the vendor intake form.

Small scheduling note: our VP (Maya) now needs to move the exec-level session originally proposed for Apr 14; she9s available on Wed Apr 15 from 15:00-15:45 PT. Would that work for Rajiv and the broader Nimbus execs?

I9ve attached the demo deck and the security checklist (for your teams to scan ahead of the session). I9m also attaching a draft purchase terms doc to give procurement something to review prior to the exec call.

Please confirm or propose an alternative 45-minute window on Apr 15 if 15:00PT is problematic. I9ll send a calendar invite once we lock the time.

Best,
Rishi

Attachments referenced: redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf, redwood-security-checklist-2026.xlsx, purchase-terms-draft.docx
message_6_subject: Re: Updated: Quarterly review + product demo — calendar + pre-call detail
message_6_body:
Rishi — thanks for coordinating. Confirming Apr 15 at 15:00PT works for me and I9ve asked our CFO to join the first 10 minutes to review commercial terms. Aisha and Tom will be there for the demo portion.

Looking forward to seeing the latency improvements and roadmap items that impact our patient portal. Please include the calendar invite and a brief agenda (we9d like: 1) Exec summary (5 min), 2) Demo (25 min), 3) Pricing & next steps (15 min)).

Regards,
Rajiv Menon | VP Operations, Nimbus Health
